data.title: Shall We Go, Then?
data.description: Frieren, Fern, and Stark leave the magic city of Äußerst behind and travel along a road in the northern lands.

data.title: The Hero of the South
data.description: In a village in the northern lands, Frieren’s party are hired to polish a statue of a hero.
Frieren’s party dream of hot springs as they reach Etwas, but the village is abandoned.
data.title: Somewhere She'd Like

data.description: Stark only asked Fern out as a joke, but the two end up going on a date.
data.title: Other People's Homes
Logistics in the Northern Plateau
data.description: Frieren is reunited with Fass the dwarf, who has been searching for the Boshaft liquor for over 200 years.

data.title: A Demon-Slaying Request
data.description: A village on the Northern Plateau is wiped out, and the victims' distinctive wounds point to a certain demon.

data.title: The Divine Revolte
data.description: Frieren, Fern, and Methode enter the woods to look for the four-armed Divine Revolte.
The Divine Revolte appears at the village, while Frieren, Fern, and Methode battle Solide and Hemmung.
data.title: A Magnificent End
Himmel’s Memoirs
data.description: When Frieren's party cannot afford the fare to cross Lake Korridor, the captain proposes a trade.
Hidden within the massive bridge spanning the Great Canyon Tor is a secret story of Himmel and Gehen.
data.title: A Beautiful Sight
